integrity: The affine Lie-derivative identity was reconstructed directly from the printed vector field and replayed with exact rational arithmetic. The compactness consequences are deductive and do not depend on numerical trajectories.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the 2021 printed autonomous system for \(b\ne0\). It does not cover the \(b=0\) boundary, an altered 2022 vector field, finite-time discretizations, or coupled/controlled network equations.
title: An affine drift rules out bounded dynamics in a reported four-dimensional Sprott-S extension
